premise: Rain comes to the meadow and every part of it plays a different note — plip on the pond, pat on the leaves, shhh in the grass, quack from Duckling — until the drops slow and stop, the sun comes back, and the song's last note makes no sound at all: a rainbow.
inspiration: Cumulative rain-song rounds (folk), turned: the whole meadow is the band, the song builds note by note, and its last note is a silent one — a rainbow.
lesson: Every small voice adds to the song.

en-US.title: Rain on the Meadow
en-US.text: {canvas:rain 0.6} {sfx:rain-bed} [softly] Plip. Plop. The rain came to the meadow, and the meadow began to play. {all:face surprised} On the pond: plip, plip, plip, like tiny bells. {frog:enter} {frog:go to pond} Frog sat at its edge, {frog:face happy} grinning. {all:pulse 0.4} On the leaves of the big trees: pat, pat, pat, like little drums. {all:wobble 0.4} In the grass: shhh, shhh, like someone whispering. {snail:enter} Snail came out to listen, and a big drop fell — {sfx:plink} PLINK! — right on his shell. {snail:live hide hold} In he went. [giggles] Along came {duckling:enter} Duckling, waddling through the wet grass. {duckling:face happy} {duckling:live quack} "QUACK, QUACK!" he sang. Plip, pat, shhh, quack! {all:face happy} {all:hop} [excited] What a song! Then the drops grew slower… drip… drip… drop. {canvas:rain stop} {canvas:sunshine} Out came the sun. {snail:live hide resume} Snail peeked out. {canvas:rainbow} [in awe] And the song's very last note made no sound at all. It was a rainbow, right over the meadow. {frog:live catch-fly} Frog snapped up a fly, {duckling:live nap hold} and Duckling tucked his head under his wing for a sunny nap. [happily] Plip, pat, shhh, quack… and a rainbow.

es-ES.title: La canción de la lluvia
es-ES.text: {canvas:rain 0.6} {sfx:rain-bed} [softly] Plic. Ploc. La lluvia llegó al prado, y el prado se puso a tocar. {all:face surprised} En la charca: plic, plic, plic, como campanitas. {frog:enter} {frog:go to pond} Rana estaba en la orilla, {frog:face happy} encantada. {all:pulse 0.4} En las hojas de los árboles: pom, pom, pom, como tamborcitos. {all:wobble 0.4} En la hierba: chsss, chsss, como quien cuenta un secreto. {snail:enter} Caracol salió a escuchar, y un goterón le cayó — {sfx:plink} ¡PLINC! — justo en la concha. {snail:live hide hold} Y se metió dentro. [giggles] Por allí llegó {duckling:enter} Patito, bamboleándose por la hierba mojada. {duckling:face happy} {duckling:live quack} —¡CUAC, CUAC! —cantó. ¡Plic, pom, chsss, cuac! {all:face happy} {all:hop} [excited] ¡Qué canción! Luego las gotas fueron más despacio… plic… plic… ploc. {canvas:rain stop} {canvas:sunshine} Y salió el sol. {snail:live hide resume} Caracol se asomó. {canvas:rainbow} [in awe] Y la última nota de la canción no hizo ningún ruido: fue un arcoíris, sobre todo el prado. {frog:live catch-fly} Rana cazó una mosca, {duckling:live nap hold} y Patito metió la cabeza bajo el ala para echarse la siesta al sol. [happily] Plic, pom, chsss, cuac… y un arcoíris.

ja-JP.title: 雨の のはらの おんがくかい
ja-JP.text: {canvas:rain 0.6}{sfx:rain-bed}[softly]ぽつん。ぽとん。のはらに雨がふってきて、のはらがおんがくをはじめました。{all:face surprised}池では、ぴちょん、ぴちょん、ぴちょん。小さなすずみたい。{frog:enter}{frog:go to pond}カエルさんは池のふちで、{frog:face happy}にっこにこ。{all:pulse 0.4}大きな木のはっぱでは、とん、とん、とん。小さなたいこみたい。{all:wobble 0.4}くさのなかでは、さあ、さあ。だれかのないしょばなしみたい。{snail:enter}カタツムリくんがききにでてくると、大きなしずくが——{sfx:plink}ぴちょーん！——からのてっぺんに。{snail:live hide hold}すぽっと、ひっこみました。[giggles]そこへ{duckling:enter}アヒルの子が、ぬれたくさのなかをよちよち。{duckling:face happy}{duckling:live quack}「ガー、ガー！」 とうたいます。ぴちょん、とん、さあ、ガー！{all:face happy}{all:hop}[excited]なんてすてきな歌！やがて、しずくがゆっくりになって…ぽつ…ぽつ…ぽとん。{canvas:rain stop}{canvas:sunshine}お日さまがでてきました。{snail:live hide resume}カタツムリくんも、ひょっこり。{canvas:rainbow}[in awe]歌のさいごの音は、なんにもきこえませんでした。それは、のはらの上にかかった、にじだったのです。{frog:live catch-fly}カエルさんはハエをぱくっ。{duckling:live nap hold}アヒルの子は、つばさにあたまをうずめて、ひなたでおひるね。[happily]ぴちょん、とん、さあ、ガー…そして、にじ。

de-DE.title: Das Regenlied der Wiese
de-DE.text: {canvas:rain 0.6} {sfx:rain-bed} [softly] Pling. Plong. Der Regen kam auf die Wiese, und die Wiese fing an, Musik zu machen. {all:face surprised} Auf dem Teich: pling, pling, pling, wie winzige Glöckchen. {frog:enter} {frog:go to pond} Der Frosch saß am Wasser {frog:face happy} und grinste. {all:pulse 0.4} Auf den Blättern der großen Bäume: tapp, tapp, tapp, wie kleine Trommeln. {all:wobble 0.4} Im Gras: schsch, schsch, als ob jemand flüstert. {snail:enter} Die Schnecke kam hervor, um zuzuhören, und ein dicker Tropfen fiel – {sfx:plink} PLOPP! – genau auf ihr Häuschen. {snail:live hide hold} Schwupp, war sie drin. [giggles] Da kam {duckling:enter} das Entchen durchs nasse Gras gewatschelt. {duckling:face happy} {duckling:live quack} „QUAK, QUAK!“, sang es. Pling, tapp, schsch, quak! {all:face happy} {all:hop} [excited] Was für ein Lied! Dann fielen die Tropfen langsamer… tropf… tropf… tropf. {canvas:rain stop} {canvas:sunshine} Die Sonne kam heraus. {snail:live hide resume} Die Schnecke lugte hervor. {canvas:rainbow} [in awe] Und der allerletzte Ton des Liedes machte gar kein Geräusch. Es war ein Regenbogen, mitten über der Wiese. {frog:live catch-fly} Der Frosch schnappte sich eine Fliege, {duckling:live nap hold} und das Entchen steckte den Kopf unter den Flügel, für ein Nickerchen in der Sonne. [happily] Pling, tapp, schsch, quak… und ein Regenbogen.

fr-FR.title: Plic, ploc sur le pré
fr-FR.text: {canvas:rain 0.6} {sfx:rain-bed} [softly] Plic. Ploc. La pluie est arrivée sur le pré, et le pré s’est mis à faire de la musique. {all:face surprised} Sur la mare : plic, plic, plic, comme des clochettes. {frog:enter} {frog:go to pond} Grenouille était assise au bord de l’eau, {frog:face happy} toute souriante. {all:pulse 0.4} Sur les feuilles des grands arbres : tap, tap, tap, comme des petits tambours. {all:wobble 0.4} Dans l’herbe : chhh, chhh, comme quelqu’un qui chuchote. {snail:enter} Escargot est sorti pour écouter, et une grosse goutte est tombée — {sfx:plink} PLOC ! — pile sur sa coquille. {snail:live hide hold} Hop, il est rentré dedans. [giggles] Et voilà {duckling:enter} Caneton, qui se dandinait dans l’herbe mouillée. {duckling:face happy} {duckling:live quack} « COIN-COIN ! » a-t-il chanté. Plic, tap, chhh, coin ! {all:face happy} {all:hop} [excited] Quelle chanson ! Puis les gouttes ont ralenti… plic… plic… ploc. {canvas:rain stop} {canvas:sunshine} Le soleil est sorti. {snail:live hide resume} Escargot a sorti ses cornes. {canvas:rainbow} [in awe] Et la toute dernière note de la chanson n’a fait aucun bruit. C’était un arc-en-ciel, juste au-dessus du pré. {frog:live catch-fly} Grenouille a gobé une mouche, {duckling:live nap hold} et Caneton a glissé la tête sous son aile pour une sieste au soleil. [happily] Plic, tap, chhh, coin… et un arc-en-ciel.

it-IT.title: Pioggia sul prato
it-IT.text: {canvas:rain 0.6} {sfx:rain-bed} [softly] Plic. Ploc. La pioggia è arrivata sul prato, e il prato si è messo a suonare. {all:face surprised} Sullo stagno: plic, plic, plic, come campanellini. {frog:enter} {frog:go to pond} Rana sedeva sulla riva, {frog:face happy} tutta contenta. {all:pulse 0.4} Sulle foglie dei grandi alberi: tum, tum, tum, come tamburelli. {all:wobble 0.4} Nell'erba: sss, sss, come qualcuno che bisbiglia. {snail:enter} Chiocciola è uscita ad ascoltare, e un gocciolone le è caduto — {sfx:plink} PLIN! — proprio sul guscio. {snail:live hide hold} Dentro, svelta! [giggles] Poi è arrivato {duckling:enter} Anatroccolo, dondolando nell'erba bagnata. {duckling:face happy} {duckling:live quack} «QUA QUA!» cantava. Plic, tum, sss, qua! {all:face happy} {all:hop} [excited] Che canzone! Poi le gocce hanno rallentato… plic… plic… ploc. {canvas:rain stop} {canvas:sunshine} È uscito il sole. {snail:live hide resume} Chiocciola ha fatto capolino. {canvas:rainbow} [in awe] E l'ultima nota della canzone non ha fatto nessun rumore. Era un arcobaleno, proprio sopra il prato. {frog:live catch-fly} Rana ha acchiappato una mosca, {duckling:live nap hold} e Anatroccolo ha infilato la testa sotto l'ala per un pisolino al sole. [happily] Plic, tum, sss, qua… e un arcobaleno.

zh-TW.title: 草地上的雨之歌
zh-TW.text: {canvas:rain 0.6}{sfx:rain-bed}[softly]滴。答。雨來到了草地上，草地就開始玩起音樂來。{all:face surprised}落在池塘上：叮、叮、叮，像小小的鈴鐺。{frog:enter}{frog:go to pond}青蛙坐在池塘邊，{frog:face happy}笑得好開心。{all:pulse 0.4}落在大樹的葉子上：咚、咚、咚，像小小的鼓。{all:wobble 0.4}落在草叢裡：沙、沙，像有人在說悄悄話。{snail:enter}蝸牛出來聽，一大滴雨落下來——{sfx:plink}叩！——剛好打在牠的殼上。{snail:live hide hold}牠一下子縮了進去。[giggles]{duckling:enter}小鴨來了，搖搖擺擺地走過濕濕的草地。{duckling:face happy}{duckling:live quack}「嘎嘎，嘎嘎！」 牠唱著。叮、咚、沙、嘎！{all:face happy}{all:hop}[excited]好好聽的歌！後來，雨點愈來愈慢……滴……答……滴。{canvas:rain stop}{canvas:sunshine}太陽出來了。{snail:live hide resume}蝸牛探出頭來。{canvas:rainbow}[in awe]這首歌的最後一個音，一點聲音也沒有。那是一道彩虹，就掛在草地的上空。{frog:live catch-fly}青蛙一口吃掉一隻蒼蠅，{duckling:live nap hold}小鴨把頭藏進翅膀底下，曬著太陽睡午覺。[happily]叮、咚、沙、嘎……還有一道彩虹。

zh-HK.title: 雨點唱歌
zh-HK.text: {canvas:rain 0.6}{sfx:rain-bed}[softly]滴……答……雨來到草地上，草地就玩起音樂來了。{all:face surprised}雨點落在池塘上：叮叮叮，好像小小的鈴鐺。{frog:enter}{frog:go to pond}青蛙坐在池塘邊，{frog:face happy}笑得見牙不見眼。{all:pulse 0.4}雨點落在大樹的葉子上：咚咚咚，好像小小的鼓。{all:wobble 0.4}雨點落在草叢裏：沙沙沙，好像有人在說悄悄話。{snail:enter}蝸牛出來聽聽，一大滴雨落下來——{sfx:plink}卜！——剛好打在牠的殼上。{snail:live hide hold}牠一下子縮了進去。[giggles]{duckling:enter}小鴨來了，一搖一擺地走過濕濕的草地。{duckling:face happy}{duckling:live quack}「嘎嘎，嘎嘎！」 牠唱着。叮叮、咚咚、沙沙、嘎嘎！{all:face happy}{all:hop}[excited]這首歌真好聽！後來，雨點愈落愈慢……滴……滴……答。{canvas:rain stop}{canvas:sunshine}太陽出來了。{snail:live hide resume}蝸牛探出頭來。{canvas:rainbow}[in awe]這首歌最後的一個音，一點聲音也沒有——原來是一道彩虹，就掛在草地上空。{frog:live catch-fly}青蛙一口吃掉一隻蒼蠅，{duckling:live nap hold}小鴨把頭埋進翅膀底下，曬着太陽睡午覺。[happily]叮叮、咚咚、沙沙、嘎嘎……還有一道彩虹。
